correction: A failed OAuth client lookup is a revoked client only when OAuth says the client is not found (oauth.ErrNotFound). Any other lookup error, such as a store that does not answer, says nothing about the client: it must not wrap events.ErrNotFound (404), so the gateway answers 503, and the subscription still goes.
evidence: frostyard/lodge#91 cross-review re-review 5 at 1498766 (openai/gpt-6.1-sol): blocking finding 1, liveClient wrapped every OAuth.Client error with ErrNotFound, so a store failure answered 404
